photos.caption: opening ceremony
Day 1, before the doors open: the Music Sanctuary hall, empty, with the mandala already glowing on the far wall.
photos.alt: A wide, empty hall with a glowing white mandala projected on the far wall. Cane stools, white chairs and standing tables are set out on the carpet.

photos.caption: Cane stools in a circle, waiting for their listeners.
photos.alt: Round cane stools with dark cushions arranged in a circle on the carpet, with instruments, a screen and the glowing mandala behind them.

photos.caption: Dhols and barrel drums on a Persian rug, with guitars and ukuleles on their stands.
photos.alt: Close view of two dhol drums and other drums lying on a red Persian rug, with guitars, ukuleles and a drum kit on stands behind, under the mandala.

photos.caption: On the opening day's stage: tabla by Dhaivat Mehta and electric guitar by Aniket Gundewar, as the banner above them reads.
photos.alt: Two musicians sit cross-legged on a rug in front of an ornate patterned backdrop: one plays tabla in a purple kurta, the other a red electric guitar. A banner above names them.

photos.caption: The tabla, up close (Dhaivat Mehta, as named on the stage banner).
photos.alt: Close-up of hands playing a pair of tabla drums. The player wears a purple kurta and sits cross-legged on a rug.

photos.caption: The first sound in the sanctuary area: saxophone, bass and voices, with a mandala on the screen beside them.
photos.alt: A small band plays in front of a screen showing a mandala: a saxophonist in a white cap and a pink and blue floral shirt, a bass player, and a singer at a microphone.

photos.caption: Day 2: the mandala reflected in glass, over people resting in the sanctuary.
photos.alt: The mandala, reflected in a pane of glass, floats over people lounging on red beanbags in pink and blue light.

photos.caption: Somewhere in the venue, a smile through a neon Ethereum diamond.
photos.alt: A smiling man seen through a glass panel that carries the reflection of a glowing Ethereum diamond logo.

photos.caption: A ukulele and a guitar at the sanctuary microphones.
photos.alt: A long-haired, bearded musician in a light denim jacket plays ukulele at a microphone, next to a guitarist in a plaid shirt.

photos.caption: Day 3: saxophone and guitar on the rug stage, with keys, cajón and dhol around them and the mandala overhead.
photos.alt: A wide view of the sanctuary stage: a saxophonist and a guitarist stand on rugs among keyboards, drums and microphones, with the mandala projected high on the wall.

photos.caption: Singing under the mandala.
photos.alt: A guitarist in sunglasses and purple sings into a microphone, framed by the glowing mandala above him.

photos.caption: A full circle: musicians in the middle, and listeners on cane stools, beanbags and the floor, between glowing neon pyramids.
photos.alt: A wide shot of a jam session: musicians in the centre on rugs, an audience sitting around them on cane stools, beanbags and the floor, with neon pyramid lights and the mandala above.

photos.caption: A singer in a white saree, smiling at the mic, with ukuleles and a djembe behind her.
photos.alt: A woman in a white saree smiles as she sings into a microphone. Behind her are a seated guitarist, a rack of ukuleles and a djembe.

photos.caption: From behind the players, looking out: the hall sits down to listen.
photos.alt: Seen from behind the performers: a singer in a teal kurta, a seated guitarist and a singer in a white saree face a large audience sitting on the floor.

photos.caption: Day 4: bass and saxophone in the afternoon jam.
photos.alt: A smiling bass player in a patterned shirt plays under pink light, with a saxophonist behind him.

photos.caption: Guitars, three across, with a singer in the foreground.
photos.alt: Three guitarists, one smiling with an acoustic guitar, play together, with the shoulder of a singer blurred in the foreground.

photos.caption: Laughter on the hand drums.
photos.alt: A long-haired, bearded man in a white kurta and a red scarf laughs as he plays hand drums opposite another drummer.

photos.caption: Two saxophones in floral shirts.
photos.alt: Two saxophonists in caps and bold floral shirts play side by side in the sanctuary.

photos.caption: Hands on a djembe.
photos.alt: Close-up of hands playing a djembe, with microphones and colourful light around it.

photos.caption: The sanctuary becomes the closing-ceremony hall: the band in the middle, the whole room sitting on the floor.
photos.alt: A huge hall in red light. A band plays in the centre on rugs while hundreds of people sit on the floor all around them.

photos.caption: Piano, voices and strings, seen from behind, facing everyone.
photos.alt: Seen from behind a pianist and a singer: the band and a vast audience seated on the floor under red lights and a patterned ceiling.

photos.caption: A performer faces the crowd under blue light.
photos.alt: A performer in a white T-shirt, seen from behind, faces a large audience sitting on the floor of a blue-lit hall.

photos.caption: A singer belting into the mic, with bass and saxophone beside him.
photos.alt: A singer in a white T-shirt sings with full voice into a microphone, with a bass guitarist, a saxophone and a guitarist in white around him.

photos.caption: Ukulele, saxophone and congas, in white and in flowers.
photos.alt: A long-haired, bearded man in a white kurta and patterned scarf plays ukulele at a microphone, next to a saxophonist in a blue cap and floral shirt and a pair of congas.

photos.caption: Two saxophones on the rug stage.
photos.alt: Two saxophonists in floral shirts play standing on a rug, with a screen behind them.

photos.caption: Dancing on stage: a balloon hat, a floral skirt, ukulele and guitars on their stands.
photos.alt: On stage, a person in a balloon hat dances with a woman in a floral skirt. A ukulele and guitars stand nearby and a screen glows behind them.

photos.caption: The team in matching jackets, arm in arm under the mandala.
photos.alt: A long line of people in matching olive-green jackets stands arm in arm across the stage, beneath the mandala.

photos.caption: Dhanteras, the first day of Diwali: the brass lamp is lit.
photos.alt: On stage under the mandala, people gather around a tall brass oil lamp as it is lit, one holding a microphone.

photos.caption: Flame to wick.
photos.alt: Close view of a man and a woman lighting the wicks of a tall brass lamp, with the mandala on the wall behind them.

photos.caption: Then the confetti.
photos.alt: Silver and pink confetti pours over a smiling crowd sitting on the floor, many holding up phones.

photos.caption: Lying back in it.
photos.alt: A grinning man in a cap and tie-dye top leans back on the floor as confetti falls all around him and the crowd.

photos.caption: Hands up in the haze, under the same mandala that watched the empty room on Day 1.
photos.alt: A packed dance floor with hands raised in the haze, light beams, and the mandala projected on the wall above.

photos.caption: Purple light, the mandala, and a full floor.
photos.alt: A crowd with hands in the air fills the floor of a hall washed in purple light, with the mandala glowing high on the wall.

photos.caption: Shouting for joy.
photos.alt: Three people in green jackets shout and grin into the camera under blue light, arms raised.

photos.caption: Hugs at the end of the night.
photos.alt: People in green jackets hug and laugh together on a dark dance floor.
